$comment: Lyra's soundcheck (Q0.9, optional): lute music drifts up from the lagoon once your first prompt's gone to the crew; follow it to her hammock. Her talk is the island's lyra.soundcheck script.

text.hint1: Hear that lute? Lyra the bard’s down on the lagoon beach, south of the village.
text.hint2: Follow the music to the hammock on the lagoon beach and talk to Lyra. It’s optional, but she tells it well.
text.announce: Lute music’s drifting up from the lagoon. Lyra the bard has a song for you.
